description: A dashboard-forward portfolio planner in Svelte 5 on the Scheduler. A portfolio-health band derived from the data sits over a timeline of squads by initiatives: a status-mix stacked bar, capacity-by-squad bars, a delivered-effort burn-up SvSparkline and an on-track SvGauge, plus a KPI strip. Initiatives are multi-week bars carrying an SvProgress meter and milestones are amber flags; zoom Month or Year, drag a bar to reschedule or hand it to another squad, drop an idea from the backlog, and every chart recomputes as the roadmap changes.

faq.question: How do the health charts stay current?
faq.answer: Every chart is a $derived over the same rows the timeline renders, so a drag that reschedules an initiative or hands it to another squad recomputes the status mix, capacity and burn-up in the same pass.

faq.question: How is progress shown on a bar?
faq.answer: The event snippet renders an SvProgress inside the bar from the row's progress field, and milestones are zero-length events drawn as flags.

faq.question: Can I hide a squad?
faq.answer: Yes. The roster checkboxes filter the rows passed to the grid, so the timeline, the table and the charts all drop that squad together.
